caption: The first recorded game of cricket in India was played in 1721, by English sailors of the East India Company at Cambay, today's Khambhat in Gujarat. Three centuries later, cricket is almost a religion here. But what if those sailors had never stepped ashore? Hockey might have stayed the national obsession. India won 8 Olympic gold medals in hockey between 1928 and 1980. Football could have had a real shot too: India qualified for the 1950 FIFA World Cup but withdrew before the tournament began. Gully cricket would become gully football, and windows would still get broken. One thing would never change, though: uncles shouting at the TV. Which sport do YOU think India would be crazy about? 👇
